faq.question: Can Strix Halo 128GB run DeepSeek-R1 32B at 64K context alongside OS workloads?
faq.answer: Yes—64K Q4_K_M uses only 36.88 GB out of 128 GB total system RAM, leaving over 91 GB for Linux/Windows, IDEs, and Docker.

title: Qwen2.5 72B on AMD Strix Halo (128GB): Smooth Up to Q8_0 & 64K (~4.0 tok/s)
meta_description: AMD Strix Halo 128GB runs Qwen2.5 72B cleanly up to Q8_0 (81.33/96.0 GB usable) and 64K Q4_K_M (65.66 GB), delivering ~4.0 tok/s at 8K with zero GPU spill.

hardware.name: AMD Ryzen AI Max+ 395 / Strix Halo (128GB)

verdict_summary: Few sub-$2,500 systems can even load Qwen2.5 72B cleanly—yet AMD Ryzen AI Max+ 395 / Strix Halo (128GB, 96.0 GB usable ROCm) keeps 80/80 layers resident from Q4_K_M (48.16 GB, ~4.0 tok/s) through Q8_0 (81.33 GB), including 64K context.

context_analysis.bottleneck_summary: With 96.0 GB usable ROCm memory outpacing 48 GB discrete cards by 2×, Strix Halo avoids the 48.16 GB 72B spill completely; instead, 256 GB/s LPDDR5X bandwidth paces generation at a steady ~4.0 tok/s (Q4_K_M) down to ~2.3 tok/s (Q8_0).
key_points: 8K Q4_K_M requires 48.16 GB (~4.0 tok/s, 80/80 layers), and expanding all the way to 64K Q4_K_M (65.66 GB, 20.0 GB KV cache) stays Smooth at ~3.3 tok/s.
Q5_K_M (55.89 GB, ~3.4 tok/s), Q6_K (64.07 GB, ~3.0 tok/s), and recommended Q8_0 (81.33 GB, ~2.3 tok/s) all fit within the 96.0 GB usable ROCm ceiling at 8K.
FP16 (149.49 GB) exceeds total 128 GB physical RAM (`50/80` layer limit) and hits OOM.
Because Q8_0 leaves only ~14.7 GB below the 96 GB GPU ceiling (and ~46 GB total RAM), Linux headless/lightweight desktop setups give the cleanest stability.
optimization_tips: Stay on Q4_K_M (`48.16 GB`, `~4.0 tok/s`)—moving to Q6_K or Q8_0 drops 72B throughput to ~2.3–3.0 tok/s over the 256 GB/s bus.
If hosting 24/7 document extraction on Strix Halo, run `llama-server` on headless Linux so no GUI compositor contends with 64K or Q6_K allocations.
Use `OLLAMA_FLASH_ATTENTION=1 OLLAMA_KV_CACHE_TYPE=q8_0` to shave 10 GB off 64K KV memory when pairing Q5_K_M (`55.89 GB`) with massive RAG context.

faq.question: Can AMD Strix Halo 128GB fit Qwen2.5 72B completely in GPU memory?
faq.answer: Yes—from Q4_K_M (48.16 GB) up to Q8_0 (81.33 GB), all 80/80 layers stay inside the 96.0 GB usable unified ROCm ceiling.

faq.question: How fast is Qwen2.5 72B on Ryzen AI Max+ 395 Strix Halo 128GB?
faq.answer: 256 GB/s LPDDR5X delivers ~4.0 tok/s in Q4_K_M at 8K (~3.3 tok/s at 64K), ~3.4 tok/s in Q5_K_M, and ~2.3 tok/s in Q8_0.

faq.question: Why does Strix Halo 128GB run Qwen2.5 72B cleaner than Dual RTX 3090 48GB?
faq.answer: Qwen2.5 72B Q4_K_M takes 48.16 GB at 8K, spilling past 47.0 GB usable VRAM on Dual 3090, whereas Strix Halo's 96.0 GB usable pool holds Q4–Q8_0 and 64K Q4 with zero spill—at the trade-off of slower ~4.0 tok/s bandwidth.

faq.question: Can Strix Halo 128GB run Qwen2.5 72B at 64K context?
faq.answer: Yes. Q4_K_M at 64K totals 65.66 GB out of 96.0 GB usable ROCm memory (~3.3 tok/s Smooth).
